newsitem.title: CANADA: Energy management division boosts TCPL Q3.
newsitem.headline: Energy management division boosts TCPL Q3.

text.p: TransCanada PipeLines Ltd said on Monday that improved results in its energy management division helped the company boost third-quarter profits by 5.6 percent over last year.
TransCanada, which operates Canada's main west-east gas pipeline system, reported third-quarter earnings of C$105 million or C$0.46 per share, up from C$99.4 million or C$0.44 per share a year ago.

It said its energy management segment, which includes the under-construction Express oil pipeline, recently acquired Alberta Natural Gas Co Ltd and Ocean State Power electricity generation facility, posted third-quarter operating income of C$47.6 million, up from C$19.1 million in 1995.
The boost came as a result of "capturing marketing opportunities" arising from volatile natural gas prices, completion of the ANG acquisition and strong energy marketing results, the company said.
TransCanada said its Canadian natural gas mainline delivered 1.799 trillion cubic feet of gas in the first nine months of this year, up from 1.729 TCF in the same period last year.
Gas marketing volumes grew to 1.179 TCF in the period, an increase from 961.4 in 1995.

The company said it also marketed 103.3 million barrels of crude oil, refined products and natural gas liquids in the first nine months of the year, up from 70.5 million barrels last year. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
